title: Executable Code Actions Elicit Better LLM Agents (CodeAct)
description: Demonstrates that having agents express actions as executable Python code (rather than JSON function calls) is superior: code is composable, can loop and branch, can define reusable functions, and produces better results on agent benchmarks. CodeAct + CodeActInstruct fine-tuning yields the best open-source agent.
authors: Wang, Chen, Yuan, Peng, He, Neubig, Jiang (CMU)
